_readme: Posts for @RealBlitzOdds. scripts/social-verify.mjs (run by .github/workflows/social-verify.yml) renders each post against the live odds endpoint the night before it's due, checks `requires`, and schedules it in Buffer only if every assertion holds; otherwise it tries `fallback`, and if that fails too it leaves the slot empty and emails alertEmail. Placeholders: {{fav:AWAY-HOME}} {{spread:G}} {{ou:G}} {{time:G}} {{network:G}} {{line:G}} {{biggest:N[:Day]}} {{closest:N[:Day]}} {{countGte:X}} {{topFavs:N}} {{maxTotal[:Day]}} {{slot:TIME}} {{slotCount:TIME}} {{dow}}. Assertion kinds: fresh, weekOdds, spreadEq, spreadGte, spreadLte, favorite, maxTotal, countGte, kickoff, dayHasGame, siteContains. dueAt is Eastern with its UTC offset (-04:00 through Nov 1, then -05:00). Weekly posts come from `weekly` (see its _readme) — the queue no longer needs to be refilled by hand.

weekly._readme: Rendered once per NFL week from data/schedule-full-2026.json. dayOffset is days from that week's Sunday (-5 Tue ... +1 Mon); time is Eastern. Variants rotate by week number. whenDay skips the slot in weeks with no game that day. A hand-written post in `posts` with the same week and slot replaces the generated one. Extra placeholders: {{week}} {{weekPlus:N}} {{matchup:G}} {{odds:G}} {{day:G}} {{count[:Day]}} {{firstTime:Day}}; G can be a key (PIT-CLE) or @OPENER / @TNF / @SNF / @MNF.
